purpose: Test whether one-stage completion-proximal short-work preplacement retains the V159 latency/QPR benefit without reserving capacity for deeper nonterminal stages.

paper_sequence_gate.homogeneous_middle_and_high_historical_b: retain unchanged and do not rerun

causal_diagnosis.dag46_topology: four functions with maximum child depth three; function 206 is the sole nonterminal function whose children are all terminal
causal_diagnosis.control_seeds: E18 and E20 are unchanged from V157, so the observed throughput-QPR trade-off is localized to E09.
causal_diagnosis.mechanism: V159 preplaces both deep and completion-proximal nonterminal stages once parents are assigned. For DAG46 this reserves capacity before the deeper stage is runnable. V160 permits only the final nonterminal stage directly preceding terminal functions, providing one-stage cold-start overlap without deeper speculative reservation.

frozen_thresholds.queue_density_definition: current pending plus runnable tasks divided by node count
frozen_thresholds.remaining_work_definition: sum over unfinished functions of cpu/mean_node_cpu + cold_start_frames/1000 + output_mb/1000
frozen_thresholds.completion_proximal_definition: nonterminal function whose immutable DAG children are all terminal functions

single_mechanism_change_from_v159.ready_players: unchanged: admit after every parent completes
single_mechanism_change_from_v159.terminal_pipeline_players: unchanged: admit when every parent has an assigned node at every queue density
single_mechanism_change_from_v159.completion_proximal_short_players: admit below queue density 8 when remaining work is at most 5.5 and every immutable child is terminal

diagnostic_selection_rule.evaluation: Replace only V155 E09, E18 and E20 with V160 and recompute the unchanged complete E01-E20 gates.

diagnostic_selection_rule.qpr_paired_gate: at least 12 of 20 wins with 20 of 20 finite-only values
diagnostic_selection_rule.joint_diagnostic_pass: every listed gate passes without editing this plan
diagnostic_selection_rule.failure: retain all three valid V160 diagnostics, retire V160 and continue mechanism analysis without running the other seventeen
